name: Ludhiana

queries.query: ਲੁਧਿਆਣਾ ਭੂ ਨਕਸ਼ਾ ਜਮਾਬੰਦੀ ਪਲਾਟ ਨੰਬਰ ਕੈਡਸਟ੍ਰਲ ਨਕਸ਼ਾ
queries.scope: Find official Punjabi-language parcel maps and verify Ludhiana tehsil coverage.
queries.result: Punjab BhuNaksha and Punjab Land Records publish bilingual/Punjabi parcel-map interfaces. Public selector calls confirm Ludhiana district and city tehsils. The viewer provides village-map WMS and identifies parcels by map click. A selected mapped village test returned plot number 10//12 and a plot bounding box, but no polygon coordinates. The selected village is outside the WUP city-center point, which was not resolved to an available village.
queries.executionMethod: Punjabi-language search and requests to official public selector, extent and coordinate-to-plot endpoints.

queries.query: Ludhiana official village cadastral map Punjab BhuNaksha parcel geometry
queries.scope: Verify current digital-map operation and city coverage evidence.
queries.result: Government BhuNaksha identifies the Punjab viewer and district hierarchy; India DILRMP reports Ludhiana district cadastral digitization status. Viewer bundle uses getPlotAtXY and ScalarDatahandler OP=4 then a WMS selection overlay. A selected mapped-village query yielded plot ID and bbox metadata only, not a full polygon.
queries.executionMethod: English-language search, official DILRMP source, city map, and live public viewer endpoint inspection.

portals.name: Punjab BhuNaksha digital cadastral map viewer
portals.operator: Punjab Land Records Society / Government of Punjab
portals.observation: Official viewer is active and Ludhiana district/urban tehsils are selectable. WMS delivers rendered maps; plot lookup exists but no complete parcel geometry response was verified.

requests.observation: Punjab state 03, Ludhiana district 11, tehsil 131, Kanungo 009, Patwar 070, village 33441 (Mangli Kadar) available and map-backed.
Selected village returns GIS code 1113100907033441 and extent x=591306.4454..592568.2307, y=3426096.9518..3427440.5449; service disclaimer says data is provisional and for viewing only.
Point inside selected village returns plot ID dpv_rp7QSbi6JEgEtR8b3A and plotNo 10//12.
Coordinate-to-plot returns has_data=Y, plot ID, village GIS code, bbox x=591892.0641..591954.0909 and y=3426763.1712..3426820.1688, plus Map Report link; response contains no polygon coordinates.

source.name: Punjab BhuNaksha digital cadastral map viewer
source.operator: Punjab Land Records Society / Government of Punjab
source.serviceType: Public selector + plot-coordinate lookup returning plot ID and bounding box; WMS plot overlay is rendered imagery; complete polygon not returned.
source.layer: VILLAGE_MAP (WMS rendered map; plot feature layer not verified)
source.nativeIdField: Village GIS code and plot number
source.nativeIdEvidence: Public selector returned village GIS code 1113100907033441 for one mapped Ludhiana East village. For a point inside that village, getPlotAtXY returned plot id dpv_rp7QSbi6JEgEtR8b3A and plotNo 10//12; ScalarDatahandler OP=4 returned the same plot id, native village GIS code, and bbox only, with a WMS Map Report link. WUP city point did not fall in that selected village extent.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official viewer is active and Ludhiana district/urban tehsils are selectable. WMS delivers rendered maps; plot lookup exists but no complete parcel geometry response was verified.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Selected mapped village in Ludhiana East tehsil returns parcel ID/number and bbox via public query; this sample lies outside the WUP city-center point and does not establish city-center coverage. No full polygon was returned.

technicalBlocker: Viewer’s official point query identifies a parcel and returns bbox/metadata only; the map shape is drawn using WMS. WUP point is outside the selected village extent and was not resolved to a city-centered mapped village.
remainingUncertainty: Whether central municipal Ludhiana is mapped under a selectable village/tehsil and whether the WMS-rendered plot can be fetched as full vector geometry.
nextStep: Resolve WUP coordinates to a selectable central-city village and test the coordinate-to-plot workflow; only proceed if a full feature geometry endpoint is found.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: City-specific registry evidence is documented in the discovery record.
